posts.hook: Your Mac is getting a lock that AI agents can't casually open
posts.caption: apple is tightening mac full disk access over ai agent risk, meta open sourced code for diy muse gadgets, amazon pledged $1b for data center communities. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Apple limits Mac Full Disk Access as AI agents raise the risk
slides.desc: Users must take ==very explicit action== to grant it, after a report that Meta's Muse referenced private messages.

terms.gloss: a mac setting that lets an app read nearly everything on the drive

slides.title: Meta open sources code to build your own Muse AI gadgets
slides.desc: Firmware for ESP32 boards and a Linux SDK put its agent on hobbyist hardware.

slides.title: A judge says a Flock license plate search was mass surveillance
slides.desc: The ruling says the officer should have got a warrant under the Fourth Amendment.

terms.gloss: a network of cameras that reads license plates for police

slides.title: Amazon pledges $1B for data center neighbors, and the backlash continues
slides.desc: It also says it dropped NDAs with county officials as moratoriums spread.

slides.title: DeepSeek and Huawei open source Ascend tools to loosen Nvidia's grip
slides.desc: Compute and communication libraries aim to make Huawei chips a workable alternative.

posts.hook: OpenAI's safety author walked out and went public, the same day a cheaper model shipped
posts.caption: an openai safety report author resigned and says the industry's culture is broken, openai shipped gpt-6.1 sol at a fifth of astra's price, cisco sd-wan has an unauthenticated admin flaw. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The man who wrote OpenAI's safety reports has quit and gone public
slides.desc: He says the industry's culture is ==fundamentally broken==, beyond what new rules could fix.

slides.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of Astra's price
slides.desc: Endor Labs says it matches Astra on security in Codex and runs a third faster, a claim to verify.

terms.gloss: a security company that tests code and ai tools

slides.title: Cisco SD-WAN flaw gives unauthenticated admin access
slides.desc: US federal agencies were given ==24 hours== to respond.

terms.gloss: software that manages a company's network links between offices

slides.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model for German and English
slides.desc: Pitched as sovereign European AI, it topped Hacker News on 312 points.

terms.gloss: the trained model files are public so anyone can run them

slides.title: Lyft settles the driver misclassification case for $272.5M
slides.desc: California says it misclassified drivers from 2016 to 2020. Uber's case continues.
